signIn.title: Sign in
error.invalid_credentials: The email or password is not right.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
error.google_not_invited: This Google account has not been invited. Ask your manager for an invite.
error.google_failed: Google sign-in did not work. Try again, or sign in with your email.
error.no_access: Your account has no access. Ask your manager.
error.email_failed: We could not send the code. Try again.
error.too_many_codes: You asked for 5 codes this hour. Try again later.
error.code_wrong: That code is not right. Check the email and try again.
error.code_expired: That code has expired. We can send a new one.
error.code_cancelled: Too many wrong tries. We can send a new code.
error.link_invalid: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.
error.password_breached: That password has appeared in a data breach. Choose another.
error.last_owner: An organization needs at least one owner.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
error.unknown: Something failed on our side. Try again.
code.title: Enter the code we emailed you
code.help: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.
code.label: Code
organization.title: Choose a hotel
organization.help: Your account works in more than one organization.
invite.title: Join {organization}
invite.expired.title: This invite has expired
invite.expired.help: Ask your manager for a new one.
invite.name: Your name
reset.request.title: Reset your password
reset.request.help: Enter your email and we will send you a link, if the account exists.
reset.request.sent: If an account uses that email, a link is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.
reset.use.title: Choose a new password
reset.use.done: Your password is changed. Sign in with it.
bell.label: Notifications
access.denied.title: You do not have access to this page.
access.denied.help: Ask your manager if you need it.
overview.title: Overview
staff.title: Staff
staff.empty: No one has been invited yet. Invite your first user.
staff.deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
staff.deactivate.help: They are signed out at once and cannot sign in again until you reactivate them.
staff.done.reset-sign-in: {name} is signed out everywhere and must sign in again.
activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: Nothing has happened yet. Changes to people and access appear here.
invite.hasAccount: You already have an account. Accept the invite, then sign in as usual.
calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.empty: No rooms are set up yet. Add room types and rooms under Rooms first.
booking.pickDates: Choose dates and a room type to see the price.
booking.full: No room is left on one of those nights.
booking.soldOut: Someone just booked the last room. Choose other dates or another room type.
error.sold_out: There is no room left on one of those nights.
error.stay_rule: That stay breaks a rule on the rate: a closed night, a minimum stay, or no arrival or departure that day.
error.past: The stay cannot start before today.
error.no_rate: One of those nights has no price set.
error.too_many_guests: That is more guests than the room holds.
error.room_not_ready: That room is not ready. Mark it clean, or assign it anyway with a reason.
error.room_taken: That room already holds another stay on those nights.
error.no_room: Assign a room before checking in.
error.too_early: That cannot be done before the arrival day.
error.already_checked_in: That guest is already checked in.
error.not_checked_in: That guest is not checked in.
error.refund_too_large: That is more than what is left of the payment.
error.contains_guest_name: This note names the guest, and housekeeping will read it. Remove the name, or send it anyway.
error.cannot_tag: You can only tag people who work at this property.
error.edit_window_closed: A note can be edited for 5 minutes after it is written.
error.wrong_type: That room is not of the booked room type.
error.cannot_cancel: A booking that has checked in cannot be cancelled.
panel.checkedOut: Checked out. The room is marked dirty.
panel.noShown: Marked as a no-show and the room is back on sale.
panel.cancelled: Booking cancelled and the room is back on sale.
panel.refundWaits: The refund is above your limit, so it waits for a manager.
thread.title: Activity and team notes
thread.placeholder: Write a note. Type @ to tag a colleague.
arrivals.title: Arrivals
arrivals.no.arrivals: Nobody is due to arrive today.
arrivals.no.departures: Nobody is due to leave today.
guests.title: Guests
guests.note: Everyone who has booked with the hotel group.
guests.search: Search by name, email or phone
guests.name: Name
guests.noStays: No stays at this property yet.
payments.title: Payments
payments.note: What was taken today, and refunds waiting for a decision.
payments.empty: No payments yet today. Card and cash payments appear here as they are taken.
rates.title: Rates
rates.note: Prices and sales rules for the next 30 days.
rates.noPlans: Create a rate plan before setting prices.
rates.none: No rate: this night cannot be sold
rates.suspicious: Saved. The price on {dates} is far from the usual, so check it.
rate-plans.title: Rate plans
rate-plans.note: How each room type is sold and what a late cancellation costs.
rate-plans.empty: No rate plans yet. Create one for each room type.
rate-plans.name: Name
rate-plans.freeDays: Free cancellation until this many days before arrival
rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.note: Cleaning for today and the status of every room.
rooms.empty: No rooms yet. Add a room type, then its rooms.
issues.title: Issues
issues.note: Things that are broken in a room. A problem can take the room out of sale.
issues.clash: Problem reported, but {n} booking(s) hold this room on those nights. Move them.
issues.empty: Nothing is broken right now. Use Report a problem when a room needs fixing.
issues.closeTitle: Mark the problem in room {room} as fixed
issues.blockHelp: Fill in both dates to take the room out of sale for those nights. Leave them empty if it stays in use.
attention.title: Needs attention
panel.badAmount: Enter the amount as a plain number, such as 120 or 12.50.
site.title: Booking site
site.note: Choose how guests can pay when they book on your website.
site.bankDetails: Bank details shown to the guest
site.kind.hotelNote: Nothing is charged online. The front desk records the payment.
site.kind.bank_transferNote: The guest sees your bank details. The booking is cancelled if no transfer arrives in time.
site.kind.cardNote: The guest pays on the payment provider's page. Needs the provider keys in the server settings.
extras.title: Extras
extras.note: What you sell besides rooms: services, tours and products. Staff add them to a stay from the booking.
extras.name: Name
group.title: All properties
group.note: How each hotel is doing today, and the sums across them.
reports.title: Reports
reports.note: Download your records to open in a spreadsheet.
reports.reservationsNote: Every stay that touches the period, with what was charged and what was paid.
chain.title: Chain rate plans
chain.note: Rate plans the whole chain shares. Set one once, and each property adds it to a room type. A change reaches every property that uses it.
chain.name: Name
chain.empty: The chain has no shared rate plans yet.
chain.linked: {name} is now a rate plan at this property.
channels.title: Channels
channels.note: Keep your rooms and prices in step with the booking sites, and bring their bookings in.
channels.modeNote.channel_manager: One connection to a channel manager, which then talks to every booking site for you.
channels.modeNote.direct: A connection to one booking site. Each site gives you its own access after you apply as a partner.
channels.hotelId: Your hotel code on their side
channels.secret: Name of the server setting that holds the password or key
channels.secretKept: Saved. Type a name only to change it.
channels.secretNote: The key itself is never stored here. Your server administrator sets it in the server settings under the name you type.
channels.mapping: Match your rate plans to theirs
channels.mappingNote: Give the room and rate codes the other side uses for each of your rate plans.
channels.synced: Sent {pushed} nights and brought in {pulled} bookings.
log.title: Sync log
log.note: What was sent to and brought in from your booking sites.
log.empty: Nothing has been synced yet. Connect a booking site on Channels, and every price and booking sent or received is listed here.
channels.unverified: This connection is written from the provider’s published message format and has not yet been run against their test system. Try it on a test hotel first.
channels.found: Found {found} rates on their side and matched {matched} of yours. Check each match, then save.
channels.cannotList: This provider cannot list its rooms. Type the codes by hand.
channels.noBookings: Google shows your prices and sends guests to your own booking site. No bookings come back through this connection.
channels.partnerNote: These channel managers take a new system only after their own approval. Until then, use Channex or Beds24, or connect straight to the booking sites.
branding.title: Branding
branding.note: The colour and logo your guests see on your booking page.
branding.contrast: The colour carries white text, so a light colour is refused.
branding.logoNote: A PNG, JPEG or WebP picture up to 2 MB.
siteContent.title: Site content
siteContent.note: The words, amenities and photos on your booking page.
siteContent.textsNote: Write the text in the language you choose. A guest who reads a language you have not written sees your own language, then English.
siteContent.photosNote: Up to 12 pictures, each up to 2 MB. Add a short caption for guests who use a screen reader.
siteContent.caption: Caption
branding.tooLight: This colour is too light for white text. Pick a darker one.
yield.title: Yield rules
yield.note: Rules that change what the booking sites see. Your own booking page is not changed.
yield.none: No rules yet. Booking sites see every room you have left, at your normal price.
yield.help.auto_close: Stop selling a room type on the booking sites when only a few rooms are left.
yield.help.sell_limit: Stop selling a room type on the booking sites after a set number of rooms are taken.
yield.help.availability_cap: Never show more than a set number of rooms to the booking sites at one time.
yield.help.rate_adjust: Raise or lower the price on the booking sites when few rooms are left.
yield.value.auto_close: Close when fewer than this many rooms are left
yield.value.sell_limit: Stop selling after this many rooms are taken
yield.value.rate_adjust: When this many rooms or fewer are left
yield.percent: Change the price by (percent, use a minus to lower)
yield.d.auto_close: Close sales when fewer than {value} rooms are left
yield.d.sell_limit: Stop selling after {value} rooms are taken
yield.d.rate_adjust: Change the price by {percent} percent when {value} rooms or fewer are left
risk.title: Review queue
risk.note: Guest bookings that look risky. Check each one, then approve or decline it.
risk.score: Risk score {score} of 100. The guest was asked for a 3-D Secure card check.
risk.declineNote: Declining cancels the booking and frees the room. If the guest already paid, refund the payment on the booking.
cancelRisk.note: A rule of thumb from the booking and the guest history, not a promise.
promo.title: Promo codes
promo.note: Codes guests type on your booking page to take money off a stay. They do not apply to booking sites.
promo.none: No codes yet. Use New code to take money off a stay on your booking page.
promo.badValue: Give the discount as a number above zero.
yield.parityNone: The booking sites show the same price as your booking page.
yield.parityNote: Nights where the booking sites are sent a different price than your booking page. A lower price on a site can take bookings away from your own page.
risk.upcomingNote: Bookings arriving in the next 14 days with a medium or high cancel risk. Call these guests or ask them to reconfirm.
risk.upcomingNone: No booking in the next 14 days has a raised cancel risk.
risk.hintsNote: Nights that are almost full where cancellations are expected. This only suggests: the system never sells above your rooms.
risk.hint: {date}, {roomType}: {booked} of {rooms} rooms taken. About {extra} more could be sold on the booking sites if you accept the risk.
pricing.title: Price suggestions
pricing.note: Suggested prices from how full each night is and what competitors charge. Nothing changes until you apply it.
pricing.noSuggestions: No change is worth making right now.
pricing.applyNote: A night you change is left alone for 7 days. Prices stay inside your floor and ceiling.
pricing.limitsNote: The lowest and highest price a room type may have, in {currency}. Leave a box empty for no limit.
pricing.badAmount: Give the amount as a number above zero.
pricing.competitorsNote: Enter what other hotels charge for a night. The suggestion uses the middle price, so one odd price does not move it.
messages.title: Messages
messages.note: What guests wrote about their bookings. Reply here and the guest gets an email.
messages.none: No guest has written yet. Guests write from the link in their booking email, and their messages appear here.
reviews.title: Guest reviews
reviews.note: What guests wrote after their stay. Hide a review to take it off your booking page, or reply to it.
reviews.none: No guest has reviewed a stay yet. Guests can review from the link in their booking email once they have checked out.
lost.title: Lost and found
lost.note: Things guests left behind. Housekeeping logs them and marks them returned or thrown away.
lost.none: Nothing is waiting to be collected. Log what housekeeping finds, so a guest who calls can be matched to it.
lost.discarded: The item is marked thrown away.
payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.note: What the payment providers took for you each day, less refunds. A guide to what to expect in the bank, not a statement.
payouts.none: No online payments in these dates.
yield.previewNone: This rule would change nothing right now.
yield.previewCount: This rule would change {count} nights. The first ones:
yield.previewRow: {date}, {roomType}: {before} rooms at {priceBefore} now, {after} rooms at {priceAfter} with the rule.
siteContent.translateNote: Writes drafts in the languages you have not filled in yet, from the language shown above. Your own texts are never replaced.
siteContent.translated: {count} texts translated. They stay drafts until you edit and save them.
siteContent.translatedNone: Every language already has its text.
siteContent.draftNote: A translation service wrote some of these texts. Check them, because a machine makes mistakes. Saving a text makes it yours.
activity.noMatch: Nothing matches. Clear a filter or search for something else.
calendar.unassignedHint: Pick a booking to give it a room.
payments.noRefunds: No refunds are waiting for a decision.
overview.vsLastMonth: {amount} in the same days last month, {pct}
overview.noLastMonth: Nothing to compare with last month yet
signIn.note: You see the screens for your role.
siteContent.preview: See the page as a guest
guests.noMatch: No guest matches "{q}". Check the spelling or search by phone or email.
